name: Tencent Hunyuan WorkForge builds 16.7K verifiable training environments for long-horizon work agents
title: Tencent Hunyuan WorkForge builds 16.7K verifiable training environments for long-horizon work agents
summary: A framework that turns expert workflows and real files into checkable workspaces, with programmatic and semantic verifiers, scaled to 16.7K environments across 40 professional domains and 60 file types. The paper reports steady gains on long-horizon work benchmarks as data and horizon grow.
